standard_prerequisites.use: Definitions of formally unramified, formally etale and formally smooth transformations of functors on (Sch/S)_fppf, and the square-zero thickening lifting criterion they are defined by. The correspondence argument in the retained author proof is not replaced by any cited result.

core_obligations: Show that when b is formally unramified, the square-zero lifting sets for a with target condition a ∘ f' = g' and for b ∘ a with target condition b ∘ a ∘ f' = b ∘ g' are in bijection, so that the three formal properties transfer from b ∘ a back to a.
Retain the bijection construction itself rather than replacing it by a citation; the three enumerated parts (unramified, etale, smooth) are discharged from that single correspondence.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up a square-zero closed immersion T ⊂ T' of affine schemes with g' : T' → G and f : T → F satisfying g'|_T = a ∘ f.
Use formal unramifiedness of b to build the one-to-one correspondence between the two lifting sets, then read the three assertions off that correspondence.

spans.label: bijection of lifting sets and formal derivation of the three parts

difficulty_reason: The real content is functorial: one must see that formal unramifiedness of b makes the map from liftings of a to liftings of b ∘ a a bijection, and that the three properties are then read off that bijection. Written out it is a short argument, but the two lifting sets displayed in the proof are built on a square-zero affine thickening and the comparison is not an instance of a standard limit or base-change step. The author's own proof is retained in full at lines 2678-2691.
